title: Park Place | KEY.co
description_expanded: As you ascend to the second floor, the space opens into an expansive gourmet kitchen, complete with a spacious center island perfect for crafting memorable family meals. The stylish dining area and bar stool seating encourage social gatherings, while the open concept layout maintains a sense of connectivity among guests. The master suite on this level features private balcony access, a king-sized bed, and a luxurious bathroom equipped with a walk-in shower and soaking tub, offering a private oasis of relaxation. The top floor hosts a TV room with comfortable seating and additional bunk beds, leading to a tower that presents stunning panoramic views of the Watercolor community. The detached carriage house, with its king-sized bed, private bathroom, and kitchenette, provides an ideal setup for those desiring extra privacy. This home is not just a place to stay; it's a distinctive experience in comfort and style, designed to create lasting memories.
